contract.purpose: The landing factory helps visitors evaluate one focused native app through product-specific language, original app evidence, plain privacy and an honest available next action.

contract.canonicalPurpose: The landing factory helps visitors evaluate one focused native app through product-specific language, original app evidence, plain privacy and an honest available next action.
contract.driftNote: The owning-project canonical provider record has no purposeContract. Repository PRODUCT.md and per-product configuration supply the current purpose; no provider or production configuration is changed.
contract.audience: Visitors evaluating one of the ten current configured native-product or successor landings.
contract.job: Understand the product, identify real evidence and reach the honest beta, release or successor action.
contract.thesis: Extend the owner-selected Living Memory Book with a distinct tactile editorial scene drawn from each product's own work.
contract.system: Retain system sans hierarchy, semantic product tokens, existing first-viewport composition, real screenshots and product-owned mascots. Landscape material scenes use stable text zones and compact stacked copy.
contract.signature: A training log for Setline, day-planning folio for Anchor, tangible arcade movement for Motion, transferred notebook for Indulge, meal journal for Calorie, archive inspection for StorageDaddy, diagnostic bench for PerformanceDaddy, tab index/compass for BrowserDaddy, context-file folio for ContextDaddy.
contract.risk: New raster scenes can weaken proof and loading. Keep app evidence and action first, disclose imagery as illustration, optimize WebP, lazy-load scenes and preserve reduced motion.
contract.qualityBar: Make every new scene specific and coherent with its existing product world; reject posed faces, fake UI, boilerplate stock photos and mismatched materials. Preserve existing heading/action hierarchy and authentic native imagery. Text must remain semantic, unclipped, high contrast and outside busy art at 390/768/1440px and enlarged text.

productSurfaces.landing: Ten current products in products/*/site.config.ts; local rendered surfaces http://127.0.0.1:8840 through :8849; canonical URLs unchanged.
productSurfaces.app: Sibling native repositories ../kith, ../setline, ../anchor, ../motion, ../calorie, ../storagedaddy, ../performancedaddy, ../browserdaddy, ../contextdaddy. Indulge is the retired predecessor of Anchor. Native design authorities and onboarding/core screen inventory recorded in product-continuity.md.

checkpoints.findingsReview: Setline score4: gradient_backgrounds on six inherited small component/device surfaces; no conic gradients or new CSS gradient wallpaper. Retain established instrument/material treatment; actual render clear text zone reviewed.

Kith and Indulge score7: intentional warm paper identity. Setline and Calorie score4: inherited device/component gradient count. Six dark products score4: perma_dark_mode is intentional native night/black utility identity, not a newly imposed default; paired native renders remain unqualified. No sampled low-contrast-text flag. Root and independent reviewers checked real text/image geometry; scores do not establish taste, native continuity or owner acceptance.

hierarchy.observation: Promise/action precede setting. Original capture or explicitly labelled artwork has its own plane. Lifecycle status stays by CTA; lengthy compact heroes postpone screen evidence.

typography.observation: System sans hierarchy is legible at real content lengths and 200% scene font. Calorie and Context have long headline/paragraph stacks. Native rounded/monospaced operation controls need not become marketing display type.

composition.observation: Art has a usable calm live-copy region. Compact copy then complete image preserves scale. Screenshot planes are distinct. Kith scene carries its photo world; other scenes repeat a shared side-table grammar more than bespoke full-page composition.

identity.observation: Setline and Storage strongest subject-specific signatures. Motion relies on logo/copy for body input. Context blank files are comparatively generic. Daddy family similarities are owner-directed; source/current-native alignment remains bounded.

interaction.observation: Independent 320px reduced-motion sessions: scene anchors resolve and FAQ disclosures open in all ten; visible skip-link focus. Kith skip moves reading start to main and next Tab enters hero action. Full-size original images are linked for screenshot/historical heroes. Actual native CTA handoff remains unobserved.

responsive.observation: Observed 320/390/768/1440 hierarchy retained; 200% desktop scene text remains readable without horizontal overflow. No observed scene text/object collision in current independent captures. 768 root screenshots are rendered evidence, not root findings.

findings: Direct independent review used; no fresh Impeccable invocation is claimed.
Pinned browser slop findings are recorded separately; no native scan or owner acceptance inferred.

comprehension.scoringBasis: Conservative weakest current landing case (BrowserDaddy, tied with Motion). Each of ten products is individually >=85; this is not an average or native acceptance.

answers.product: A native Mac browsing-history and attention tool.
answers.audience: Mac users wanting to inspect their own browsing across browsers.
answers.value: Bring history together, separate visits from measured attention and revisit useful patterns.
answers.mechanism: Separate local history archive plus measured foreground/idle-aware attention; access determines evidence.
answers.proof: Explicit Tab Scout product artwork, not a native screen or history screenshot. No interface proof in the opening.
answers.nextAction: Download macOS15+ early-access build or read how it works.

designSystem.observation: Native authoritative themes and existing captures compared; Anchor neutral tokens corrected. Fresh current rendered native pairs are incomplete.

vocabulary.observation: Scoped current source onboarding and landing task/action labels compared; historical Indulge labels corrected. No fresh all-app walkthrough claimed.

productTruth.observation: Concept/history/access labels remain honest; download HEAD responses prove endpoint availability only. Native current artifact/use verification remains incomplete.

handoff.observation: Four actual CTA clicks reach invite-only beta pages. Five public Mac download endpoints return200. No fresh installation/onboarding to first useful native state observed; Browser fixture built/launched but native UI selection failed.
